notes: Heads for שַׁחַל and כְּפִיר are placed on the creature noun ('lion', 'lions'), reading 'fierce' and 'young' as the ASV's specifiers on the model of rule 31's 'sea monsters'; the competing reading heads כְּפִיר on 'young', since 'lions' alone is any lion, and remains defensible under the same subtraction test.
Every 'the' in the verse is supplied — no article morpheme is present — so each goes to the word it stands before (rules 15, 29).
